 Advertisement Updated: 2:35 PM EST Nov 19, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ By Laura Rysz Toyota issues recall for thousands of vehicles due to airbag degradation
 Updated: 2:35 PM EST Nov 19, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ By Laura Rysz Toyota has issued a recall for more than 314,000 cars, trucks and vehicles, the U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said on Wednesday.
 According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration , the vehicles are being recalled over a potential issue with Takata Corporation airbags. The NHTSA said that the passenger-side airbags could spray metal shards throughout the vehicle cabin, which may result in serious injury or death.
 Advertisement Related videos above: How to stay ahead of recalls 
 Models affected include the 2002-2010 Lexus SC430, 2011 IS250, 2017 GX460, 2003-2008 Toyota Corolla, 2005-2006 Tundra, 2005-2007 Sequoia, and 2016-2017 4Runner vehicles. 
 Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed beginning Dec. 28. 
 Owners can contact Toyota's customer service at 1-800-331-4331. Toyota's numbers for this recall are 26TB25, 26TA25, 26LB11, and 26LA11.
